scope: Within each workflow JSONL, use monotonic timestamps and explicit request/invocation/parent identities. Tool rounds contain all observed tool starts between adjacent ordinary submissions; completion requires every tool end and uses their maximum. Internal summary requests are excluded from ordinary submissions. Summary spans include model queueing, service and transport, not pure GPU computation or client idle. Intersect their interval union with each completion-to-submit gap. Unknown spans remain unknown; unclosed tool/submit boundaries are retained. Summed spans may overlap across workflows and source cohorts, so they are neither elapsed run time, exposed stall nor counterfactual JCT savings. No quality, causal performance or DMA overlap claim is made.
